name: L-Train x Chef Mario | 200mg Infused Olive Oil | Garlic
description:
Enhance your meals with L-Train x Chef Mario's signature infused olive oil, featuring 200mg of cannabis evenly incorporated into premium Italian imported Extra virgin olive oil. Designed to complement savory, sweet, fresh and baked dishes, this edibles delivers consistent potency with a smooth, balanced flavor. This easy to use oil is Ideal for cooking, finishing, or drizzling on top of your favorite foods wherever you are. The strongest & best tasting infused oil on the market yet!

The infused Garlic oil is great for adding a full bodied assortment of flavors to any boring meals or those just plain missing that beloved taste, highly recommended with meals like L-Train pizza, bowls, and shawarma's.
